facts.fact: 过路人发现她的车遗弃在镇外老公路边——门开着、引擎运转、两岁女儿在后座尖叫。
facts.anchor: A passerby found her car abandoned at the side of a road just outside town

facts.fact: 丈夫出示短信记录，给了绑架时间窗；无摄像头无证人。
facts.anchor: He showed us their text log. We got a timeframe for the abduction

facts.fact: 现场装置：软管从龙头绕过房梁，对着储水槽滴水；槽已满到边。
facts.anchor: A hose was rigged from a spigot, wrapped around the rafter overhead

facts.fact: 钢桌上用铰链固定钢椅，后仰约三十度，靠背斜到水线——头沉在水面下。
facts.anchor: was a steel chair, leaned back at roughly a thirty-degree angle

facts.fact: 首饰分文未取——不是财务动机、不是抢劫。
facts.anchor: Thousands, maybe tens of thousands of dollars to be taken. But they were left in place.

facts.fact: 受害者清醒经历全程：指甲抠椅臂弯折两根、皮带下皮肤磨破。
facts.anchor: Her nails were bent back, two broken from how hard she’d been clawing at the arms of the chair.

facts.fact: Alex 黑历史闪回：多年前醒来发现同样的束缚带在自己手腕上。
facts.anchor: when she’d woken up to find them around her own wrists.

facts.fact: Alex 断言凶手预谋：要她受苦——不只是溺死之痛，还有恐惧与等待。
facts.anchor: He wanted it to hurt. He wanted her to suffer. Not just the pain of drowning, but the dread and expectation of it.

facts.fact: 章末：Alex 对 Lacey 宣誓要查到底。
facts.anchor: But I’m going to find out.
